pages.text: Tough As Nails tracks your $(bold)temperature$(). The bar by your hotbar swings cold in winter nights, snowy biomes, deep water and high altitude; hot in deserts, the Nether, and midsummer noon.$(br2)Thirst is $(bold)off$() in this pack. Temperature is the survival layer.

Counters: wool and leather armor warm you; campfires, torches and lava warm the air near them; shade, water and ice cool you. Climate clothing from TAN is the long-term answer.$(br2)Icy or scorching for too long hurts. Plan the first winter: a roof, a fire, and wool.
